BL-1909 — start_bridge_headless.sh defaults BRIDGE_EXTENSION_HOST_ROOT to the literal /home/carillon/swarmforgevc and wait_for_expedite_then_bedtime.sh defaults its root the same way, so on any other host the bridge fallback silently finds nothing and on this one a root with no build silently borrows the live checkout's; both default to the checkout the running script belongs to
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: Raised by the coder in BL-1886's review. No choice is posed. FIRM: an explicit BRIDGE_EXTENSION_HOST_ROOT still wins; a project's own build still wins over any fallback; with neither, the fallback is the checkout the running script belongs to. Medium severity, so it waits for your approval.
